author: From Staff Reports
title: BOYS BASKETBALL ROUNDUP: Three Gwinnett Teams Win at On the Radar Showcase - NewsBreak
text:
By From Staff Reports ,
5 hours ago Raheem Dyce LAWRENCEVILLE — Archer’s boys basketball team won for the third time in four games on Wednesday, topping Greater Atlanta Christian 61-46 in the On the Radar Thanksgiving Showcase at Central Gwinnett.
Raheem Dyce scored 18 for the Tigers (3-5), and teammate T.J. Tunstall scored 15.
Archer has held its last three opponents to 53, 46 and 46 points.
BOYS BASKETBALL
North Cobb Christian 78, Dacula 56
LAWRENCEVILLE — Despite 31 points from Case Presley, Dacula lost 78-56 to North Cobb Christian in Wednesday’s On the Radar Thanksgiving Showcase at Central Gwinnett.
Kenny LaRue added 15 points for the Falcons.
Peachtree Ridge 65, SW Macon 63
LAWRENCEVILLE — Peachtree Ridge battled back for a 65-63 win over Southwest Macon on Wednesday in the On the Radar Thanksgiving Showcase at Central Gwinnett.
Micah McMorris (20 points), Noah Jones (18 points) and Duan Day (10 points) were the top scorers for the Lions (2-2).
Grayson 86, Central Gwinnett 58
LAWRENCEVILLE — Grayson defeated host Central Gwinnett 86-58 in Wednesday’s nightcap of the On the Radar Thanksgiving Showcase.
The Rams (4-0) had four double-figure scorers led by 19 points, five rebounds, two assists, two blocks and two steals from M.J. Curry.
Malik Rideout followed with 16 points, three assists and two steals, and Donaven Thomas had 15 points, five assists and two rebounds.
Grayson also got contributions from Austin Leonard (10 points, four rebounds), Byron Lee (nine points, eight rebounds) and Jacorri Thompson (six points, eight rebounds, two steals).
